name: count_char_a
doc: Return how many times the letter 'a' appears in s.

name: remove_char_a
doc: Return s with every 'a' removed.
tests: assert remove_char_a('tables matches singing') == 'tbles mtches singing'

name: count_char_b
doc: Return how many times the letter 'b' appears in s.

name: remove_char_b
doc: Return s with every 'b' removed.
tests: assert remove_char_b('cherry jumped dance river') == 'cherry jumped dance river'
assert remove_char_b('river reader apple') == 'river reader apple'
assert remove_char_b('fixed quickly debug redo') == 'fixed quickly deug redo'

name: count_char_c
doc: Return how many times the letter 'c' appears in s.

name: remove_char_c
doc: Return s with every 'c' removed.
tests: assert remove_char_c('banana redo matches cherry') == 'banana redo mathes herry'
assert remove_char_c('softly apple under banana') == 'softly apple under banana'

name: remove_char_d
doc: Return s with every 'd' removed.
tests: assert remove_char_d('jumped under global') == 'jumpe uner global'
assert remove_char_d('banana final dance') == 'banana final ance'

name: count_char_e
doc: Return how many times the letter 'e' appears in s.

name: remove_char_e
doc: Return s with every 'e' removed.
tests: assert remove_char_e('cherry intake softly') == 'chrry intak softly'
assert remove_char_e('aaa apple rain') == 'aaa appl rain'
assert remove_char_e('final cherry preview rain') == 'final chrry prviw rain'
assert remove_char_e('debug intake fixed boxes') == 'dbug intak fixd boxs'

name: count_char_i
doc: Return how many times the letter 'i' appears in s.

name: remove_char_i
doc: Return s with every 'i' removed.
tests: assert remove_char_i('preview quickly final global') == 'prevew quckly fnal global'

name: count_char_l
doc: Return how many times the letter 'l' appears in s.

name: remove_char_l
doc: Return s with every 'l' removed.
tests: assert remove_char_l('export singing coder') == 'export singing coder'
assert remove_char_l('reader matches abc unit') == 'reader matches abc unit'
assert remove_char_l('dance matches abc fixed') == 'dance matches abc fixed'
assert remove_char_l('rain export cherry') == 'rain export cherry'

name: count_char_n
doc: Return how many times the letter 'n' appears in s.

name: remove_char_n
doc: Return s with every 'n' removed.
tests: assert remove_char_n('station station unit abc') == 'statio statio uit abc'
assert remove_char_n('export aaa redo') == 'export aaa redo'

name: count_char_o
doc: Return how many times the letter 'o' appears in s.

name: remove_char_o
doc: Return s with every 'o' removed.
tests: assert remove_char_o('intake coder matches aaa') == 'intake cder matches aaa'
assert remove_char_o('fixed export preview') == 'fixed exprt preview'
assert remove_char_o('fixed unit unit boxes') == 'fixed unit unit bxes'
assert remove_char_o('debug fixed dance') == 'debug fixed dance'

name: remove_char_r
